attchmntText: Suraksha Diagnostic Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: Suraksha Diagnostic Limited has disclosed the audio recording of its earnings call held on November 13, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. IST. The call discussed the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The audio file is available on the company website at the specified URL. This intimation is filed pursuant to Regulation 30(6) and 46(2) of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosures Requirements Regulations, 2015. The announcement was signed by Shreya Arora, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.

attchmntText: Suraksha Diagnostic Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Suraksha Diagnostic Limited filed a disclosure regarding an investor presentation for its earnings call on November 13, 2026. The presentation covers unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. For H1 FY27, revenue from operations was INR 1,867.2 Mn, representing 23% year-on-year growth. EBITDA stood at INR 678.5 Mn with a margin of 36.3%, while profit after tax was INR 278.0 Mn with a margin of 14.9%. The company performed 4.50 Mn tests across 77 centers. For Q2 FY27, revenue was INR 990.71 Mn, EBITDA was INR 363.17 Mn, and PAT was INR 149.50 Mn. The company commissioned five new centers during the quarter. The earnings call schedule is subject to change.

attchmntText: Suraksha Diagnostic Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a revised press release dated November 10, 2026, titled "Corrigendum to the Press Release-Financial Performance for the Quarter and Half Year endedSeptember 30, 2026 dated November 10, 2026".
voiceSummary: Suraksha Diagnostic Limited issued a corrigendum to its press release dated November 10, 2026, regarding financial performance for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company corrected inadvertent errors in the Key Operational Highlights. Total tests for Q2 FY27 are revised to 2.40 million from 2.32 million. Tests per patient for Q2 FY27 are revised to 5.70 from 0.42. Average revenue per test for Q2 FY27 is revised to 412 rupees from 427 rupees. For H1 FY27, total tests are revised to 4.50 million from 4.42 million. Tests per patient for H1 FY27 are revised to 5.63 from 0.80. Average revenue per test for H1 FY27 is revised to 415 rupees from 422 rupees. The updated document is available on the company website.

attchmntText: Suraksha Diagnostic Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Clarification regarding Non-Publication of Newspaper Advertisement under Regulation 47 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015'.
voiceSummary: Suraksha Diagnostic Limited clarifies that the newspaper advertisement for financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, was not published in the Pune and Ahmedabad editions of Business Standard. The company submitted content and instructions to the newspaper agency on Wednesday, November 11, 2026, within the prescribed timeline. The delay in Pune and Ahmedabad was due to a public holiday in those regions, which prevented publication on the scheduled date. The company states this was beyond its control. The advertisement was published in all other states within the stipulated timeline. Business Standard confirmed no issues were released in some editions due to Diwali and Bhai Duj, with specific publication dates listed for various cities. Suraksha Diagnostic requests this clarification be taken on record.
